name: @materyalph/api-contract
description: OpenAPI 3.1 source and generated-client boundary for MateryalPH

scripts.generate:typescript: openapi-generator-cli generate -i openapi.yaml -g typescript-fetch -o generated/typescript --additional-properties npmName=@materyalph/api-client-ts --additional-properties supportsES6=true --additional-properties typescriptThreePlus=true
scripts.generate:dart: openapi-generator-cli generate -i openapi.yaml -g dart-dio -o generated/dart --additional-properties pubName=materyalph_api_client --additional-properties pubVersion=1.0.0
